tldr: Morning batch, Aug 13: a model-release heavy window — xAI ships Grok 4.6 (matches OpenAI's best on the AI Intelligence Index at 60% lower price), DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 posts huge agent-benchmark gains at $0.435/$0.87 per M tokens, and Qwen open-weights its first Max-class model (Qwen3.8, 2.4T params). OpenAI expands Daybreak with GPT-5.6-Cyber for defensive security, Meta opens Muse Glimmer weights after a lab rebuild, and Gemini's share keeps sliding (12%→1.9%) while Anthropic climbs. Research: prompts can now be reverse-engineered from output text, and Cohere ships a 2.4B open VLM.

articles.title: xAI Ships Grok 4.6 — Matches OpenAI's Best, 60% Cheaper
articles.summary: Grok 4.6 scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, tying GPT-5.6 Sol; ~53 agentic steps vs Opus 5's 103 at >60% lower price ($2/$6 per M tokens).

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 Drops With Huge Agent Gains
articles.summary: Production V4 Pro build: DeepSWE 12.8→62.7, CyberGym 52.7→83.3, Terminal Bench 72.1→87.9; $0.435/$0.87 per M tokens, 1M context — near Fable-5 on agent tasks.

articles.title: Qwen Drops Open Weights for Qwen3.8-Max (2.4T Params)
articles.summary: First Qwen-Max-class open model: 2.4T total / 95B active, 512 experts, hybrid attention, 262K context; text-only weights with vLLM + SGLang day-0.

articles.title: OpenAI Expands Daybreak With GPT-5.6-Cyber for Defensive Security
articles.summary: New frontier model for authorized cybersecurity work; Daybreak Blue gives defenders GPT-5.6 Sol access for vuln discovery, code review, and incident response.

articles.title: Meta Opens Muse Glimmer Weights; Zuck Rebuilt the Lab After Llama 4
articles.summary: Zuck announces open weights for Muse Glimmer (Muse Spark 1.2 soon), admitting Llama 4 missed the mark — so he rebuilt the frontier lab from scratch.

articles.title: Gemini Is Bleeding Market Share to ChatGPT and Claude
articles.summary: Pangram: Gemini fell from 12% to 1.9% in July while OpenAI holds >50% and Anthropic climbed 4.3%→14.9%; Similarweb and OpenRouter confirm the trend.

articles.title: Researchers Reverse-Engineer LLM Prompts From Output Text
articles.summary: IIT Bombay + Adobe's 'Previous-Token Prediction' trains an inverse model that reconstructs prompts near-perfectly — no weight access needed, works cross-model.

articles.title: Meta's Muse Glimmer 30B Now Runs Up to 3.3x Faster on Mac With mlx-dspark
articles.summary: Speculative decoding on Apple Silicon: 8-bit Muse Glimmer 30B goes 8.2→18-26 tok/s on an M4 Pro — math 3.27x, code 2.5x, chat 2.22x speedups.

articles.title: Cohere North Micro Vision Instruct: 2.4B Open-Weight VLM
articles.summary: Apache 2.0 vision-language model with native-resolution image support — a compact foundation for prototyping, fine-tuning, and specialized multimodal apps.

articles.title: Anthropic's Top Agent Workflow: Adversarial Code Review
articles.summary: LLM bugs skew toward system design and missing context, not off-by-ones — a one-line adversarial review prompt or Claude's built-in /code-review catches them.
